parameter.name: httpPort
parameter.label: Port
parameter.description: HTTPS port of the camera local API (default 443)

parameter.name: username
parameter.label: Username
parameter.description: Camera account username as set in the Tapo app

parameter.name: password
parameter.label: Password
parameter.description: Camera account password as set in the Tapo app

parameter.name: pollingInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Refresh interval for refreshing the data in seconds (0=disabled). Setting it below 10 seconds may cause communication issues (not recommended).
